name: call_guest
description: Place a phone call to a guest or contact the receptionist explicitly asks to call, and ask them the exact question the receptionist stated. Use it only when the receptionist names or numbers a specific person to call AND states what to ask or tell them. Never call anyone on your own initiative.

to_number.description: Destination phone number in E.164 format, e.g. +34612345678. Take it from the receptionist's instruction or the hotel directory lookup; never invent a number.

question.description: The exact question or message to deliver, in the receptionist's own words, translated into the guest's language if known. Do not add questions.

guest_name.description: Name or room of the person to call, for the greeting.

token.secret_value: <CALLING_WEBHOOK_SECRET - set at deploy time, never committed>
